findings.evidence: `<div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item" id="s3-customcontrol">`
findings.fix: Use `` instead.
findings.violation: A div with role="button" should be replaced with a native button element for proper semantics and built-in keyboard support.

findings.evidence: `read the accessibility improvements list`
findings.fix: Change the link text to "read the fare history" or change the href to a URL that actually contains accessibility information.
findings.location: Section 3, Fare adjustments, paragraph with link
findings.violation: The link text "accessibility improvements list" does not match the destination URL "/fares/history" which refers to fare history.

findings.fix: Change the label to "Direction" or provide actual route names/numbers as the option values.
findings.violation: The label "Route" conflicts with option values that represent directions, not route names.

findings.fix: Remove aria-invalid="true" and only set aria-invalid="true" when validation actually fails.
findings.location: Section 3, form field, Promo code input
findings.violation: aria-invalid is set to true before any validation has occurred, which misleads screen reader users into thinking there is a current error.

findings.evidence: `Enter a 6 character code using letters and numbers only.`
findings.fix: Hide this span by default and only display it when validation fails, or reclassify it as helper text with appropriate styling.
findings.location: Section 3, form, error message below promo field
findings.violation: The error message is displayed by default on page load, making it unclear whether this is a current error or instructional text.

findings.evidence: `<div class="wizard-steps" id="s3-wizard">` containing "Choose a plan", "Enter payment details", and "Confirm your order" steps
findings.fix: Move the wizard to its own section with explanatory text, or provide heading and instructions explaining what plan selection process it represents.
findings.location: Section 3, Fare adjustments, wizard steps element
findings.violation: A multi-step checkout wizard appears unexplained in the middle of a fare adjustments information section with no context for its purpose.
